# hyperfluid_virtual_machine (Data Source)

Look up a virtual machine by name within an environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "hyperfluid_environment" "default" {
  name = "default"
}

data "hyperfluid_virtual_machine" "web" {
  env  = data.hyperfluid_environment.default.id
  name = "web"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `env` (String) Environment id.
- `name` (String) Virtual machine name.

### Read-Only

- `cpu` (String) Number of vCPUs.
- `description` (String) Free-form description.
- `disk` (String) Root disk size.
- `id` (String) Virtual machine id.
- `image_key` (String) Image key.
- `image_source_ref` (String) Image source name.
- `install_media` (String) `Attached` or `Removed` for an installer image; null for a disk image.
- `ip_address` (String) Primary IP address of the guest.
- `memory` (String) Guest memory.
- `phase` (String) Lifecycle phase.
- `running` (Boolean) Whether the virtual machine is meant to run.
- `slug` (String) Derived slug.
- `tags` (List of String) User-defined tags.
- `user_data_secret_name` (String) Secret holding the cloud-init user-data, if any.
